findings.title: Failed journal entry delete removes the entry from the list anyway
findings.expected: When the delete request fails, the entry stays in the list next to the error, because it still exists on the server.
findings.actual: The entry is removed from the list straight away and is not put back when the DELETE returns 500. The page shows the error, but the entry is gone from view (the list falls back to 'No journal entries yet' while the badge says '1 entry'), even though the server still has it.

findings.title: Malformed journal response on the plant page is drawn as junk entries with no error
findings.expected: A visible error saying the journal could not be loaded.
findings.actual: No alert appears. The list shows made-up entries with date '–', blank text and Edit/Delete buttons.

findings.title: Bad journal payload on the plant page shows 'No journal entries yet' while the badge says 2 entries
findings.expected: An error, not an empty state.
findings.actual: When the list request returns {}, the page shows 'No journal entries yet' next to a '2 entries' badge, and no error.

findings.title: Search over 80 characters shows a raw validation message and hides all results
findings.expected: The search box limits input to what the API accepts, or explains the limit in plain words.
findings.actual: The box takes any length. At 81 or more characters the API returns 422 and the page shows 'Query.q: String should have at most 80 characters' in place of the results.
